verdict.rationale: Qodo's pricing FAQ states that it does not train models on your code and uses it only to generate reviews, so no-training is the default with no opt-out step needed. Plans also list strict data retention, and Qodo documents self-hosted, on-prem and air-gapped deployment that keeps data inside your own infrastructure. Missing for 10: detailed first-party privacy/DPA documentation of the no-training commitment, coverage of non-code data such as PR chat and comments, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
